WRONG: a large grey nobody zone over Armenia, Azerbaijan, Shirvan and eastern Anatolia, plus Safavid/Ottoman contest stripes; neither state claims the land the Safavids took in 1603-1606.

issues.what: The 1609 keyframe snaps of the Safavids (Cliopatria shape without the Caucasus) and of the Ottomans (dossier correction removes a 250 km disc around Tabriz plus Azerbaijan and Armenia) leave 541 cells without owner: Shirvan, Azerbaijan, Armenia, East Azarbaijan (Safavid 370) and Van/Hakkari/Iraqi Kurdistan edge (Ottoman 171). The ledger had given the Safavids Tabriz (21 Oct 1603), Nakhchivan (Oct 1603), Yerevan (June 1604), Ganja, Baku, Shirvan and Shamakhi (June 1606).

Tumed's 200 km Hohhot disc reaches 102 cells into Ming Shanxi (size rule gave it to the Tumed, 134 cell-years in 1600 and again at the 1609 snap). Page: Tumed pastures lay 'north of the border with Shanxi'. Still Tumed: 23 Inner Mongolia and 9 Shaanxi cells (no page on them) and 3 Shanxi edge cells.

The state of New Mexico (1,067 cells, the heart of the Santa Fe de Nuevo Mexico province that the New Spain dossier's own 1598 keyframe gives to New Spain) was nobody's from 1600 to 1608 because the Spanish Empire's 1600 keyframe drops it while the province's fringe (Arizona, south Colorado) was New Spain's.

Hole in the Tsardom of Russia at the end of 1609: its 1609 keyframe (Cliopatria, verdict ok) drops 891 cells (Tver 225, Kaluga 116, Orel 108 and 15 more regions) to nobody during the Time of Troubles; the Smolensk and Seversk contest sits on top. Pages: False Dmitry II took Karachev and Bryansk and won Yaroslavl, Kostroma, Vologda, Kashin (undated); the Time of Troubles page dates only Dmitry's flight to Kaluga (late Dec 1609) and the siege of Smolensk (Sept 1609); neither says who held Tver, Kaluga or Orel.

Tsardom of Russia Siberia: the 1600 keyframe drops 5,000 cells (Yamal-Nenets, Krasnoyarsk, Novosibirsk), the ledger returns Mangazeya 1601 and Tomsk 1604, the 1609 keyframe adds Yamal-Nenets, Krasnoyarsk and Tomsk back.

Viceroyalty of Peru 1600 snap adds 4,260 cells (Cordoba, Santa Fe, Santiago del Estero and 36 more regions of Argentina); the dossier's keyframe 1600-1716 is 'Spanish South America about 1700 without Chile, Cuyo and Venezuela', a dossier-level choice that looks generous for 1600 (Chaco and Pampas); no page opened.
Balkh: the Safavid ledger has Abbas holding it 1599-1602 but the Bukhara 1600 keyframe takes it (43 cells, size rule), so the Safavid loss of 1602 moves nothing; not checked against a page.

Japan 1600: warring-states-japan ends, Tokugawa keyframe drops Hiroshima, Hyogo, Okayama; the western land stays under the shogunate (130 cells, Toyotomi 13) with Satsuma, Mori (Yamaguchi), Uesugi, Date and Matsumae winning their conflicts as smaller states.

Caucasus conflicts with the Ottomans (Kakheti, Kartli, Mingrelia, Abkhazia, Artsakh, Kuku) and Iberian Union overlaps with France, Liege and the Nabhani: smaller state wins, small cell counts, no page contradicts.

Karabakh and the rest of Azerbaijan outside the Safavid gain regions stay Ottoman in 1609 (an olive pocket inside Safavid land); the Safavid ledger/41 gains Karabakh at the Treaty of Nasuh Pasha (20 Nov 1612).

dossier_requests.what: Corrections of tumed_1547 to tumed_1609 draw a 200 km disc around Hohhot, which overlaps Ming Shanxi (about 102 cells) and parts of Shaanxi and Inner Mongolia; replace by the Hohhot plain minus Shanxi, so that windows other than p1600-p1609 (1547-1599 and 1610-1635) are fixed too.
dossier_requests.why: Page: the Tumed pastures lay 'north of the border with Shanxi, in present-day Inner Mongolia'; the patch rulings/0 only covers 1600-1609.

dossier_requests.what: safavid-dynasty_1609 and safavid-dynasty_1600 corrections assume Cliopatria's Safavid shape already contains the 1603-1606 gains (the 1600 text says 'for 1603-1608 use the 1609 shape'); it does not, so the keyframe snap erases them. The patch overrides the 1609 keyframe; the 1612 keyframe should be checked the same way.
dossier_requests.why: Page dates Tabriz 21 Oct 1603, Yerevan June 1604, Ganja, Baku, Shirvan and Shamakhi June 1606.

dossier_requests.what: ottoman-empire_1609 correction removes a 250 km disc around Tabriz, which also takes Van, Hakkari and the Iraqi Kurdistan edge; use the exact regions of the Safavid gains instead (the patch does this for 1609).

problems: keyframe_overrides/0 and /1 replace the whole 1609 keyframes of safavid-dynasty and ottoman-empire, whose span in shapes.csv is 1609..1611; they snap only in 1609, so p1610-p1619 sees the effect only through the 1610 anchor, but the 1612 keyframes of both states (first year of p1610-p1619) should be checked: the Safavid 1612 and Ottoman 1612 shapes may snap the Caucasus again.

rulings/0 (ming-dynasty over tumed in Shanxi) covers 1600-1609; the same disc overlaps Ming Shanxi in 1547-1599 (p1500-p1599 windows, the 1599 anchor still has 105 Tumed cells in Shanxi, which the 1600 snap now hands to the Ming) and in 1610-1635; neighbouring windows should give the same ruling or the dossier should be fixed.

Russia: the Tsardom's 891 cells of Time-of-Troubles hole (Tver, Kaluga, Orel and 15 more regions) remain nobody's at the p1610 anchor; the p1610-p1619 agent should decide whether it stays (Cliopatria shape, verdict ok) when it handles the 1610 keyframe.

events/0 gives the whole state of New Mexico (1,067 cells) to viceroyalty-of-new-spain from 1600, following the dossier's own 'New Mexico (province)' region of 1598; the Spanish Empire's 1609 keyframe asks for 49 more New Mexico cells, which New Spain keeps (colony). The province region itself (2,208 cells, including Arizona and south Colorado) is wide for settlement from Santa Fe and San Juan; that choice is the dossier's.

The trial also shows changes that do not come from this patch (dossier edits since the 1 Nov 2026 compile): a new duchy-of-pomerania conflict with holy-roman-empire-minor-states (276 cell-years, 3 years) and with polish-lithuanian-commonwealth (12), a holy-roman-empire-minor-states_1602 snap, and kazakh-khanate_1600 no longer snapping.

15 Ottoman and 2 Safavid cells still go to nobody at the 1609 snaps (12 Ottoman in Hungary around 47-48N 18-21E, 2 in Georgia, 1 on the Caspian coast; 1 Bahrain and 1 Gilan cell Safavid), because Cliopatria's 1609 Ottoman shape lacks them; too small to patch without a page.
